decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Any plant and machinery, including that for fume extraction, ventilation, refrigeration and air conditioning, which may be used by reason of granting this permission, shall be so installed, used and thereafter retained as to prevent the transmission of noise, vibration, and odour/fume into any neighbouring premises, including the approved mitigation details as shown in the Ventilation Report on Method and Materials document.

<p>The noise reduction and anti-vibration measures detailed in Plant Noise Assessment Report by Aran Acoustics (dated 29 July 2024) shall be fully implemented prior to use and maintained as such thereafter. The level of noise emitted from any new plant including that used for ventilation, refrigeration, air conditioning and fume extraction shall be lower than the existing background level by at least 10LpA. Noise levels shall be determined at one metre from the window of the nearest noise sensitive premises. The background noise level shall be expressed as the lowest LA 90 (10 minutes) during which plant is or may be in operation.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p>240503-DWG-010 – Location Plan and Block Plan; 240704-DWG-011 Rev A – Existing Floor Plan; 240704-DWG-012 Rev A – Existing Section; 240704-DWG-013 Rev A – Existing Rear Elevation; 240704-DWG-015 Rev A – Proposed Floor Plan; 240704-DWG-016 Rev A – Proposed Section; 240704-DWG-017 Rev A – Proposed Rear Elevation; 240704-DWG-018 Rev A – Existing Side Elevation; 240704-DWG-019 Rev A – Proposed Side Elevation; 240704-DWG-020 Rev A – Existing Side Facing North Elevation; 240704-DWG-021 Rev A – Proposed Side Facing North Elevation; Proposed Kitchen Ventilation System; Cover Letter by Mahir Al-Rubaiee (dated July 2024); Ventilation Report on method and materials; Plant Noise Assessment Report by Aran Acoustics (dated 29 July 2024)</p><p>All documents received 02.10.24</p>
